scope: Metadata example only; one changed parameter with other assumptions held fixed.

checks.text: 單參數敏感度：固定水線面積1200 m²及外水密度1025 kg/m³，只把新增質量由600 t降至300 t。ΔT=m/(ρA)由0.4878 m降至0.2439 m，恰為一半；此比例限小吃水變化與固定水線面積，不適用浸沒後水線形狀明顯改變的狀態。~For a one-parameter sensitivity comparison, hold waterplane area at 1200 m² and external density at 1025 kg/m³, reducing only added mass from 600 t to 300 t. ΔT=m/(ρA) falls from 0.4878 m to 0.2439 m, exactly half. This scaling assumes small draft changes and a constant waterplane, not substantially changed submerged geometry.

另作固定姿態的敏感度比較：力臂維持1.5 m、淨重量與浮力矩−2 MN·m、摩擦矩0.5 MN·m，只把水壓合力4 MN改為5 MN。需求轉矩F×1.5−2+0.5由4.5增至6.0 MN·m，增加33.33%；這是獨立力擾動，不把它當作水位變動時力臂也固定的真實閘門預測。~At the same posture, keep the lever arm at 1.5 m, net weight-buoyancy moment at −2 MN·m and friction moment at 0.5 MN·m, changing only water resultant from 4 MN to 5 MN. Required torque F×1.5−2+0.5 rises from 4.5 to 6.0 MN·m, or 33.33%. This isolated force perturbation does not predict a real stage change, which may also shift the lever arm.

靜水壓敏感度固定ρ=1025 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²及大氣壓101.3 kPa，只將水深8 m增為10 m。表壓ρgh由80.442增至100.5525 kPa，增加25%；絕壓則由181.742增至201.8525 kPa，其增幅不是25%。比較只包含靜水柱，不推定送氣管損、閘門浮力或動態壓力同步變化。~For hydrostatic sensitivity, hold ρ=1025 kg/m³, g=9.81 m/s² and atmospheric pressure 101.3 kPa fixed, increasing only depth from 8 m to 10 m. Gauge pressure ρgh rises from 80.442 to 100.5525 kPa, or 25%; absolute pressure rises from 181.742 to 201.8525 kPa, not by 25%. This column calculation does not infer pipe losses, gate buoyancy or dynamic pressures.

降雨敏感度固定集水區A=2 km²與逕流係數C=0.75，只將雨強i由60改為90 mm/h；兩情境都假設降雨歷時超過集流時間。沿用同一單位換算式Q=0.278CiA，流量由25.02增至37.53 m³/s，增加50%。此線性比較未納入C隨飽和改變或渠道滯蓄，也不是泵站所需容量的直接決定。~Hold catchment area A=2 km² and runoff coefficient C=0.75 fixed, changing only rainfall intensity i from 60 to 90 mm/h; both storms last beyond concentration time. With the same unit-converted relation Q=0.278CiA, flow increases from 25.02 to 37.53 m³/s, or 50%. This linear comparison excludes saturation-related changes in C and channel storage and does not directly determine pumping capacity.

均衡水位的單參數比較固定閘室面積20000 m²、初始水位10 m及池面積10000 m²，只將池初始水位由4升至6 m。同基準下最終水位由8 m升為(20000×10+10000×6)/30000=8.6667 m；池升2 m只令共同水位升0.6667 m。這是兩固定面積水體的封閉體積平衡，未計船舶移動、漏水或外部補水。~For equalization sensitivity, keep chamber area 20000 m², initial chamber level 10 m and basin area 10000 m² fixed, raising only initial basin level from 4 m to 6 m. On the common datum, final level rises from 8 m to (20000×10+10000×6)/30000=8.6667 m. A 2 m basin change raises the common level only 0.6667 m. This closed-volume comparison excludes vessel movement, leakage and external supply.

提升功率敏感度固定速度0.2 m/s與g=9.81 m/s²，只將不平衡質量由100 t降至50 t。純重力功率Δmgv由196.2降至98.1 kW，減少50%；這只是相同速度下需克服的重力項。摩擦、啟停加速度、再生回送和傳動效率仍須另計，不能因此宣稱整機耗電也減半。~For lifting-power sensitivity, hold speed at 0.2 m/s and g at 9.81 m/s², reducing only imbalance mass from 100 t to 50 t. Gravity-only power Δmgv falls from 196.2 to 98.1 kW, a 50% reduction in that component. Friction, starting acceleration, regeneration and drive efficiency remain separate, so total machine electricity consumption need not halve.

水位差敏感度固定槽面積200 m²、ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²及水平力臂12 m，只將單槽多出的水深0.02 m減為0.01 m。Δm=ρAΔh由4 t降至2 t，重力轉矩ρAΔhgr由470.88降至235.44 kN·m。減半關係只適用此水平姿態的集中質量模型，不代表整圈轉動的實際電能或任意角度轉矩。~Hold gondola area 200 m², ρ=1000 kg/m³, g=9.81 m/s² and horizontal lever arm 12 m fixed, reducing only excess depth from 0.02 m to 0.01 m. Imbalance Δm=ρAΔh falls from 4 t to 2 t and gravity torque ρAΔhgr from 470.88 to 235.44 kN·m. Halving applies to this horizontal concentrated-mass model, not full-rotation electricity use or torque at every angle.

風險敏感度保留50年期限與各年獨立、平穩假設，只將年超越機率p由0.001改為0.002。由100[1−(1−p)⁵⁰]計算，累積機率由4.8794%增為9.5253%，並非精確翻倍。此比較說明非線性的期間換算，不假定氣候、暴露或防護性能在真實未來50年必然不變。~Retain the fifty-year horizon and independent stationary years, changing only annual exceedance probability p from 0.001 to 0.002. The relation 100[1−(1−p)⁵⁰] changes cumulative probability from 4.8794% to 9.5253%, not exactly double. This illustrates nonlinear horizon conversion without asserting that climate, exposure or protection performance will actually remain stationary for fifty years.

鋪層節拍比較固定面積5000 m²及厚度0.3 m，因此需料1500 m³不變，只將有效供料率250增至300 m³/h。t=V/Q由6 h降至5 h，供料率增加20%而時間減少16.67%。模型仍未含邊緣修整、設備等待及接縫時間限制；增加供料不能被直接解讀為所有施工工序都縮短相同比例。~Keep lift area 5000 m² and thickness 0.3 m fixed, so volume remains 1500 m³, increasing only effective supply from 250 to 300 m³/h. Duration t=V/Q falls from 6 h to 5 h: 20% more supply gives 16.67% less time. Edge finishing, equipment queues and joint-time limits remain excluded; other construction tasks need not shorten by the same proportion.

薄拱公式的局部敏感度固定均勻徑向壓力0.5 MPa和半徑80 m，只將厚度由8增加至10 m。理想壓應力σ=pR/t由5降至4 MPa，減少20%。比較保持無彎曲的連續圓拱假設；真實加厚會改變三維剛度、溫度與拱梁分載，不能把此倒數關係視為完整拱壩設計結論。~For local sensitivity of the thin-arch relation, hold uniform radial pressure 0.5 MPa and radius 80 m fixed, increasing only thickness from 8 m to 10 m. Ideal compression σ=pR/t falls from 5 to 4 MPa, a 20% reduction. The comparison retains a continuous circular arch without bending; actual thickening changes three-dimensional stiffness, temperature and arch-cantilever sharing, so the inverse relation is not a complete dam-design conclusion.

密度敏感度固定顆粒密度2700 kg/m³，只將乾密度由2100提高到2200 kg/m³。n=1−ρd/ρs由0.2222降至0.1852，即孔隙率約由22.22%降至18.52%。這是相同顆粒密度下的體積比例比較，仍忽略顆粒內孔隙及含水修正誤差；單由孔隙率下降不能推定壓縮模數或滲透係數變化量。~Hold particle density at 2700 kg/m³ and change only dry density from 2100 to 2200 kg/m³. Porosity n=1−ρd/ρs falls from 0.2222 to 0.1852, approximately 22.22% to 18.52%. This volume-ratio comparison still excludes intraparticle pores and moisture-correction error; the porosity change alone does not determine changes in compressibility or permeability.

達西敏感度固定平均水力坡降5與通流面積1000 m²，只將k由10⁻⁹增至2×10⁻⁹ m/s。Q=kiA由5×10⁻⁶增至10⁻⁵ m³/s，即0.005增至0.010 L/s，恰為兩倍。這要求同一均質、無裂縫材料內仍可用線性達西流；若提高流量是裂縫或繞流造成，就不能只用調整均質k來解釋。~For Darcy sensitivity, hold gradient five and flow area 1000 m² fixed, changing only k from 10⁻⁹ to 2×10⁻⁹ m/s. Q=kiA doubles from 5×10⁻⁶ to 10⁻⁵ m³/s, or 0.005 to 0.010 L/s. This assumes linear Darcy flow in the same homogeneous uncracked medium; increased flow from cracking or bypass cannot be explained solely by adjusting homogeneous k.

空隙率敏感度固定理論最大密度2500 kg/m³，只將體積密度2450提高至2475 kg/m³。空隙率100(1−ρb/ρmax)由2%降至1%，是降低1個百分點而非降低1%。比較假定材料組成和測定方法不變；它不設定施工壓實目標，也未據此證明瀝青心牆的抗滲或低溫變形性能。~Hold theoretical maximum density at 2500 kg/m³ and change only bulk density from 2450 to 2475 kg/m³. Air-void content 100(1−ρb/ρmax) drops from 2% to 1%, one percentage point rather than a 1% relative decrease. Composition and measurement method remain fixed. This comparison neither sets a compaction target nor establishes permeability or cold-temperature deformation performance.

排水導度敏感度固定上游水頭50 m、出口10 m與入流導度0.002 m²/s，只將排出導度由0.008降為0.004 m²/s。節點穩態水頭H=(CinHu+CoutHd)/(Cin+Cout)由18升至23.333 m；排水導度減半並不令水頭翻倍。這是線性集總網路兩個穩態的比較，沒有描述堵塞後升壓的時間過程或三維裂隙分布。~Hold upstream head 50 m, outlet head 10 m and inflow conductance 0.002 m²/s fixed, reducing only outflow conductance from 0.008 to 0.004 m²/s. Steady node head H=(CinHu+CoutHd)/(Cin+Cout) rises from 18 to 23.333 m; halving drainage conductance does not double head. The linear lumped network compares two steady states, excluding transient pressurization and three-dimensional fractures.

自由熱收縮敏感度固定單塊長24 m與α=10⁻⁵/K，只將均勻降溫量由12增至18 K。ΔL=αLΔT由2.88增至4.32 mm，增加50%。比較保持自由收縮邊界；若塊體受到拘束，額外冷卻可能轉化為應力而非相同的位移，兩塊之間的接縫實際開度還取決於各自運動和接觸狀態。~For free-contraction sensitivity, hold block length at 24 m and α=10⁻⁵/K fixed, increasing only uniform cooling from 12 K to 18 K. ΔL=αLΔT rises from 2.88 to 4.32 mm, or 50%. The comparison retains free contraction; restraint may turn added cooling into stress rather than the same displacement, while actual joint aperture depends on both blocks and their contact state.

導流渠糙率敏感度固定寬10 m、水深3 m、坡度0.001，因此A=30 m²與R=1.875 m不變，只將曼寧n由0.025增至0.030 s/m^(1/3)。Q=AR^(2/3)S^0.5/n由57.701降至48.084 m³/s，約減少16.67%。這是指定水深下均勻流輸水能力的比較；若指定流量不變，應另解新水深，不能同時固定流量與水深。~Hold channel width 10 m, depth 3 m and slope 0.001 fixed, retaining A=30 m² and R=1.875 m, and increase only Manning n from 0.025 to 0.030 s/m^(1/3). Uniform-flow capacity Q=AR^(2/3)S^0.5/n falls from 57.701 to 48.084 m³/s, approximately 16.67%. This compares capacity at prescribed depth; prescribing unchanged discharge instead requires solving for a new depth.
